BiblicalUsage: Lᵉṭûwshim means Letushim, an Arabian tribe — rare in the text, and exact where it appears. In Genesis 25:3, "and Letushim".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Letushim is named once beside his brothers, and that is enough — God kept the sons of Dedan in the record.
